description: [PAID $0.002 USDC per call via x402] Deterministic, publicly recomputable random integers derived from a FINALIZED block hash and a salt. Refuses a block that is not yet final. Not secret and not for cases where the salt can be chosen after seeing the block.

chain.description: EVM CAIP-2 chain id such as eip155:8453, or a bare chain id number as a string. Chain names are refused.

name: random_from_block
title: Verifiable randomness from a finalized block
